Meta Platforms' revenue grew from $134,902M in FY2023 to $164,501M in FY2024 [DOC-1], a growth rate of (164,501 − 134,902) / 134,902 = 21.94%.

Amazon's net sales grew from $574,785M in FY2023 to $637,959M in FY2024 [DOC-1], a growth rate of (637,959 − 574,785) / 574,785 = 10.99%.

Note on comparability: Meta reports this line item as "revenue" while Amazon reports it as "net sales" — both represent top-line sales/revenue and are generally comparable in substance, though the labeling differs slightly due to differing disclosure conventions between the two companies [DOC-1]. No divestitures, spinoffs, or fiscal-year mismatches are indicated in the excerpt.

Meta's revenue growth (21.94%) outpaced Amazon's net sales growth (10.99%) by approximately 10.95 percentage points.

ANSWER: Meta grew faster, by approximately 10.95 percentage points (21.94% vs. 10.99%)
